subject: Request: transient headroom insurance + pro-rata terms for launch
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — headroom for our Feb 28 product launch

Hi Stephanie,

We’re ramping up for a public launch on Feb 28 and expect a few hours per day where throughput spikes ~6-8x vs our baseline for roughly 72 hours over the month. Our infra team asked whether Redwood supports a short-term "insurance" product we can buy that:

- Guarantees additional GPU headroom above our reserved commit for short windows
- Has a clear cooldown/eligibility definition (so we’re not billed permanently)
- Supports pro-rated billing if we start mid-billing-cycle

If you have a standard add-on or a sample quote, can you share? Also tagging procurement (procurement@brightlayer.com) — they’ll need T&C and DocuSign-ready language.

Thanks,
Liam O'Neill
Head of Platform, BrightLayer Labs
Attachment: rough_traffic_curve.png (image)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — headroom for our Feb 28 product launch

Hi Liam — great to hear about the launch, congrats.

Short answer: yes, we offer a transient headroom add-on for Dedicated customers. High-level:

- Pricing model: two-part (reserve step-up commit + surge rate). You can buy a time-bound headroom slice (e.g., +100 GPU-minutes/hour) for a calendar window; when used it consumes burst units billed at a premium per GPU-minute.
- Cooldown: standard cooldown is 72 hours after a sustained full-capacity event; we can add an exception for launch events with prior notice.
- Pro-rata: we can pro-rate the activation fee if signed mid-billing-cycle; surge usage is billed daily.

I attached a quick pricing workbook with three scenarios (low/med/high). I’ll loop in Karthik for discounts and Marcus for operational constraints so we can get you DocuSign language for procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik to propose a pricing band + one-time activation fee
2) Marcus to confirm throughput guarantees (tokens/sec and warm K/V cache expectations) and any rollout windows
3) If acceptable, legal/LAURA produce a one-page addendum we can sign for Feb 20 activation

Would you prefer a short call today or tomorrow to review numbers?

—Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: transient_headroom_pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 12:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — headroom for our Feb 28 product launch

Team — forwarding Liam's ask. Key constraints from product: must keep predictable unit economics for both parties. My thoughts:

- Offer an activation fee (one-time) to reserve the time-window and capacity: $6k for a 7-day window +/- 2 days flexibility.
- Surge rate: $2.50 / GPU-minute (applies only when burst units used beyond reserved commit); capped daily at 10% of guaranteed monthly commit to avoid runaway bills.
- Cooldown carve: allow a single "launch exception" per contract year if we get 72-hour prior notice; otherwise standard 72-hour cooldown.

Questions for Marcus:
- Can we provide an operational SLA during the window (e.g., 95th percentile token latency under a specified sequence length)?
- Any constraints on warm cache guarantees across zones?

Karthik — if we need to offer a discount tier (for startups or NRR-based) what band would you accept pre-approval for on AE sign-off?

Thanks,
—Steph

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — headroom for our Feb 28 product launch

Hi — quick pricing guidance from my side:

- Activation fee: $5,000–$7,500 depending on flexibility window and whether BrightLayer wants exclusive warm slices (we normally don’t reserve exclusive GPU hardware, but we can guarantee priority queuing).
- Surge rate: $2.00–$2.75 / GPU-minute. Recommend we offer $2.25 for a 10% discount if they commit to a minimum top-up of 2,500 GPU-minutes for the month.
- Cap: rather than a % of monthly commit, prefer an absolute daily cap (e.g., 1,000 GPU-minutes/day) tied to the purchased headroom slice; easier for billing and avoids surprises.
- Pro-rata: activation fee pro-rated daily; surge usage billed on next invoice but with a line-item provisional charge if mid-cycle usage happens.

Approval matrix: AE (Stephanie) can sign up to $5k activation + standard surge; anything beyond needs pricing lead approval. I can sign off to $6.5k if Marcus confirms operational feasibility.

Laura — any redlines we should pre-clear for the launch exception language? Simple clause: "Launch event exemption: one-time exception to cooldown if customer provides 72 hours' notice and activation payment is received 7 days prior."

—Karthik

From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam@brightlayer.com>, procurement@brightlayer.com
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — headroom for our Feb 28 product launch — proposed addendum

Hi Liam and team —

Thanks for the patience. Based on internal alignment, here’s the proposed transient headroom offering tailored for BrightLayer Labs:  

Summary (straight to the numbers):
- Activation fee: $6,000 (pro-rated daily if signed mid-cycle)
- Headroom slice: up to 1,000 GPU-minutes/hour across your Dedicated pool for a 7-day window (chosen window: Feb 26–Mar 4)
- Surge rate: $2.25 / GPU-minute for actual usage beyond your reserved commit
- Daily cap: 1,000 GPU-minutes/day (billed if exceeded; recommended to avoid runaway usage)
- Cooldown/launch exception: one-time launch exception allowed if Redwood receives 72 hours' notice and activation payment at least 7 days before the window; otherwise standard 72-hour cooldown applies
- SLA: operational target of 95th percentile token latency under agreed sequence length (Marcus will follow up with specific numbers and monitoring hooks)

Attachments: 1-page addendum (MAA_draft.pdf) and the detailed pricing scenarios spreadsheet we discussed. If this looks good I’ll have Legal prepare the DocuSign.

Next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm DocuSign contact and sign-off authority
2) If agreed, sign addendum by Feb 20 to ensure provisioning for Feb 26
3) Marcus will schedule a short runbook call to confirm warm cache priming and traffic shaping during the window

Would you like me to tee up the DocuSign draft now?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
